summary: F1 resolved by deletion: the sentence this diff added to design.md's image section asserted the image carries no credential material and no estate facts and that everything beyond the clone arrives as environment variables — the shipped image bakes image/terraform.rc (tfmirror.home, TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE) and homelab-root.crt into the trust store, neither an environment variable, both required for terraform init to resolve pvginkel/homelab. The sentence is gone; its true credential half was already carried by D33 and design.md's identity table, so nothing the phase owed is lost. The same false clause the diff added to history.md's new arc ('the container carries no estate facts at all') narrows to what the configuration ruling actually decided — no cluster fact is committed in ArgoCDTools. F2 is advisory and untouched. Gate re-run per this repo's conventions (added lines under 100 columns outside tables, links resolve); done-record updated and committed as bb3f73a.
